headline: GEL (CONMAT) crashes 25% on a price gap, the steepest one‑day decline in today’s coverage.
market_take: Volatility was pronounced across sectors, with CONMAT and PROP leading the moves. Several large price gaps and intraday swings were recorded, notably GEL -25% and AWC +11.94% on volume spikes. High‑impact filings this week include TTCL’s set‑clarification, STPI’s capital reduction and acquisition disposal, and QHBREIT’s paid‑up capital decrease. Overall, the market shows heightened trading activity and regulatory scrutiny.

sector_notes.note: GEL fell 25% on an open price gap and TPIPL rose 7.06% with strong volume; recent AGM resolutions for EPG and SCC were filed.
AWC surged 11.94% with a 4.5σ volume spike and intraday +9.49%; RML and CGD posted double‑digit intraday gains; PRIN recorded a -100% price gap and its AGM resolution was disapproved.
Multiple alerts: AQUA showed a -9.09% gap and +10% intraday move, XBIO -11.11% gap, MADAME +9.72% intraday, and CFRESH had a 3.1σ volume spike; ITC filed a high‑priority connected‑transaction notice.
PLE dropped 22.22% intraday, SOLAR -8.33%, CNT -6.19%; TTCL posted a 33.3% 5‑day gain and filed a set‑clarification; STPI had several capital‑change and acquisition‑disposal filings.
SSPF rose 6.87% intraday, M‑PAT fell 6.47% over five days, KTBSTMR showed a 3.6σ volume spike, and FUTURERT and QHBREIT disclosed capital‑change transactions.
PPPM reported a board‑level share‑holding restructuring.
